method: Independent Ybus assembly, load admittance conversion at PF load-flow operating point, generator internal voltages behind Xdprime, Kron reduction, analytic power-angle Jacobian, NumPy eigensolver.
caveat: Independent dynamics from input model values, but operating point is the supplied PF load-flow solution. Native Amat is not used in construction. Assumes no transformer shunt or phase shift; all exported project types have zero values for those.
mechanical_convention: Native PF: disconnected turbine power pt is constant; mechanical torque=pt/n. With i_speedVar=2 the voltage and stator flux ignore n, so electrical torque is Pe on nominal-speed base. Explicit D=0, but the linearized mechanical conversion contributes -P/(2 H S) to speed diagonals.
reference: TechRef Synchronous Machine PF2024 sections6.1.2.4 and6.5, equations102,171,172. G02 is the rotor-angle speed reference.
ideal_power_swing_warning: The textbook swing equation with (Pm-Pe)/n gives two zero roots and zero speed diagonal. Its eigenvalues differ from the native classical PowerFactory reference beyond the declared comparison tolerance. The PF model is preserved, and the documented mechanical convention is reproduced independently.
